You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Question: Which category does a safety component with self-evolving behaviour based on machine learning fall under?

Facts:
[0] safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour — listedIn — Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions (Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]
[1] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems (Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[2] self-evolving machinery — requiresMeasure — adapting machinery or a related product (adapting machinery or a related product) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[3] Arresto di sicurezza — hasSafetyFunction — Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1:1999 (categoria 3) [condition: o comunque come previsto dalla valutazione del rischio] [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4]
[4] Arresto di emergenza — hasSafetyFunction — Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1:1999 (categoria 3) [condition: o comunque come previsto dalla valutazione del rischio] [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4]
[5] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity (devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity) [condition: where those obstacles could give rise to a risk to the health and safety of persons or domestic animals or to the safe operation of the machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[6] Autonomous mobile machinery — definedAs — has an autonomous mode, in which all the essential safety functions of the mobile machinery are ensured in its travel and working operations area without permanent interaction of an operator (has an autonomous mode, in which all the essential safety functions of the mobile machinery are ensured in its travel and working operations area without permanent interaction of an operator) [condition: all essential safety functions ensured without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[7] Universal Robots robots built-in safety functions — hasSafetyFunction — Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture (PL d, category 3) [ur5e-manual, p. 109]
[8] impianto robotizzato — hasSafetyFunction — Riavviamento Inatteso (riavviamento inatteso) [robot-cell-sheet, p. 3]
[9] safety component — definedAs — a component: — which serves to fulfil a safety function, — which is independently placed on the market, — the failure and/or malfunction of which endangers the safety of persons, and — which is not necessary in order for the machinery to function, or for which normal components may be substituted in order for the machinery to function (a component: — which serves to fulfil a safety function, — which is independently placed on the market, — the failure and/or malfunction of which endangers the safety of persons, and — which is not necessary in order for the machinery to function, or for which normal components may be substituted in order for the machinery to function) [condition: which is independently placed on the market] [DIR, Art. 2]
[10] safety component — definedAs — a physical or digital component, including software, of a product within the scope of this Regulation, which is designed or intended to fulfil a safety function and which is independently placed on the market, the failure or malfunction of which endanger the safety of persons, but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function (a physical or digital component, including software, of a product within the scope of this Regulation, which is designed or intended to fulfil a safety function and which is independently placed on the market, the failure or malfunction of which endanger the safety of persons, but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function) [condition: but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[11] Safety function — definedAs — Function of a machine whose failure can result in an immediate increase of the risk(s) (function of a machine whose failure can result in an immediate increase of the risk(s)) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 147]
[12] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices (an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices) [condition: with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[13] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: Where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[14] built-in safety functions of UR10e — hasSafetyFunction — Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture (PLd, category 3) [ur10e-manual, p. 110]
[15] macchina — hasSafetyFunction — almeno un comando di arresto di emergenza (at least 1) [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4]
[16] 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[17] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[18] control system — requiresMeasure — designed to perform the safety functions by itself (designed to perform the safety functions by itself) [condition: For autonomous mobile machinery or related product; even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[19] componente di sicurezza sostituito — requiresCheckAfter — dopo l’installazione (installazione) [unict-guideline, p. 10]
[20] Supervisory function — definedAs — remote non permanent surveillance of autonomous mobile machinery by a device allowing to receive information or alerts and to give limited orders to this machinery (remote non permanent surveillance of autonomous mobile machinery by a device allowing to receive information or alerts and to give limited orders to this machinery) [condition: by a device receiving information or alerts and giving limited orders] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[21] control systems for pedestrian-controlled machinery — addressesRisk — inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver (inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver) [REG, Annex III, 3.3.4]
[22] Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility — definedAs — machinery the operation of which requires either mobility while working, or continuous or semi-continuous movement between a succession of fixed working locations, or — machinery which is operated without being moved, but which may be equipped in such a way as to enable it to be moved more easily from one place to another (machinery the operation of which requires either mobility while working, or continuous or semi-continuous movement between a succession of fixed working locations, or — machinery which is operated without being moved, but which may be equipped in such a way as to enable it to be moved more easily from one place to another) [DIR, Annex I, 3.1.1]
[23] machinery with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: where several fixed or rail-mounted machines can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[24] non-fully automated machinery with incorporated tool — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into non-fully automated machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 2.3]
[25] isola robotizzata — safeguardedSpaceRule — sospese provvisoriamente alcune protezioni (sospese provvisoriamente alcune protezioni) [condition: a condizione che vengano automaticamente adottati altri criteri di sicurezza] [robot-cell-sheet, p. 5]
[26] UR10e robot arm in Recovery Mode — hasSafetyFunction — Stop Category 0 (stop category 0) [condition: if a violation of these limits appears] [ur10e-manual, p. 200]
[27] essential requirement 1.7.1.2 (warning devices) — addressesRisk — a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery (a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[28] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately (devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately) [condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[29] sostituzione di parti, dispositivi o componenti di sicurezza — mustKeepRegister — registrate secondo gli schemi del Modello C (Modello C) [condition: Qualora l’intervento di manutenzione richieda la sostituzione di parti, dispositivi o componenti di sicurezza] [unict-guideline, p. 9]
[30] robot — safeguardedSpaceRule — vi devono essere fermi meccanici o altri limitatori di corsa in grado di bloccarlo (vi devono essere fermi meccanici o altri limitatori di corsa in grado di bloccarlo) [robot-cell-sheet, p. 2]
[31] effectiveness of the protective measure — requiresCheckAfter — each change to the machine, the integration or the operating and boundary conditions of the safety laser scanner (each change to the machine, the integration or the operating and boundary conditions of the safety laser scanner) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 104]
[32] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX (conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[33] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — operatedwithout being moved, but which may be equipped in such a way as to enable it to be moved more easily from one place to another (operatedwithout being moved, but which may be equipped in such a way as to enable it to be moved more easily from one place to another) [condition: machinery operated without being moved but which may be equipped to be moved more easily] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[34] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 3.6.3.3]
[35] Universal Robots safety functions and safety I/O — hasSafetyFunction — PLd Category 3 (ISO 13849-1) (PLd Category 3) [ur10e-manual, p. 236]
[36] automatic-charging batteries of mobile machinery — addressesRisk — hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1 (hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1) [condition: when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station] [REG, Annex III, 3.5.1]
[37] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex II) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[38] control systems, safety and reliability — addressesRisk — hazardous situations (hazardous situations) [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.1]
[39] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — requires either mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between a succession of fixed working locations (requires either mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between a succession of fixed working locations) [condition: the operation requires mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between fixed working locations] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[40] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[41] UR5e safety functions and safety I/O — hasSafetyFunction — PLd Category 3 (PLd Category 3) [ur5e-manual, p. 229]
[42] reasonably foreseeable misuse — definedAs — the use of machinery or a related product in a way not intended in the instructions for use, but which may result from readily predictable human behaviour (the use of machinery or a related product in a way not intended in the instructions for use, but which may result from readily predictable human behaviour) [REG, Annex III]
[43] downstream control elements — integratorResponsibleFor — must evaluate the output signals of the protective device in such a way that the dangerous state of the machine is safely ended (must evaluate the output signals of the protective device in such a way that the dangerous state of the machine is safely ended) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 42]
[44] manufacturer — hasObligation — the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part of the risk assessment performed by the manufacturer and no modifications are allowed to the settings or rules generated by the machinery or related product or by operators, including during the machinery or related product learning phase, where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations (the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part of the risk assessment performed by the manufacturer and no modifications are allowed to the settings or rules generated by the machinery or related product or by operators, including during the machinery or related product learning phase, where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations) [condition: Control systems shall be designed and constructed in such a way that] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[45] robot integration — integratorResponsibleFor — Perform a risk assessment (perform a risk assessment) [ur10e-manual, p. 4]
[46] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[47] movement of machinery depending on safe positioning of parts — requiresMeasure — movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning (movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning) [condition: where it does not give rise to other risks] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[48] starting in automatic mode — addressesRisk — hazardous situation (hazardous situation) [condition: provided this does not lead to a hazardous situation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.3]
[49] robot integration — integratorResponsibleFor — Perform a risk assessment (perform a risk assessment) [ur5e-manual, p. 4]
[50] human-machine interface — requiresMeasure — adapting the human-machine interface (adapting the human-machine interface) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[51] self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[52] stationary machinery — requiresMeasure — a parking device (a parking device) [condition: Where safety so requires] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[53] Supervisor — definedAs — a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery (a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery) [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[54] Driver — definedAs — operator responsible for the movement of machinery or a related product, who may be transported by the machinery or may be on foot, accompanying the machinery, or may guide the machinery by remote control (operator responsible for the movement of machinery or a related product, who may be transported by the machinery or may be on foot, accompanying the machinery, or may guide the machinery by remote control) [condition: may be transported by the machinery, on foot, or guide it by remote control] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[55] manufacturer — definedAs — any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive and is responsible for the conformity of the machinery or the partly completed machinery with this Directive with a view to its being placed on the market, under his own name or trademark or for his own use (any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive and is responsible for the conformity of the machinery or the partly completed machinery with this Directive with a view to its being placed on the market, under his own name or trademark or for his own use) [condition: under his own name or trademark or for his own use] [DIR, Art. 2]
[56] lifting accessory — definedAs — a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery, allowing the load to be held, which is placed between the machinery and the load or on the load itself, or which is intended to constitute an integral part of the load and which is independently placed on the market (a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery, allowing the load to be held, which is placed between the machinery and the load or on the load itself, or which is intended to constitute an integral part of the load and which is independently placed on the market) [condition: which is independently placed on the market] [DIR, Art. 2]
[57] putting into service — definedAs — the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by this Directive (the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by this Directive) [DIR, Art. 2]
[58] harmonised standard — definedAs — a non-binding technical specification adopted by a standardisation body, namely the European Committee for Standardisation (CEN), the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardisation (CENELEC) or the European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI), on the basis of a remit issued by the Commission in accordance with the procedures laid down in Directive 98/34/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 June 1998 laying down a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations and of rules on Information Society services ( 16 ) (a non-binding technical specification adopted by a standardisation body, namely the European Committee for Standardisation (CEN), the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardisation (CENELEC) or the European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI), on the basis of a remit issued by the Commission in accordance with the procedures laid down in Directive 98/34/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 June 1998 laying down a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations and of rules on Information Society services ( 16 )) [DIR, Art. 2]
[59] authorised representative — definedAs — any natural or legal person established in the Community who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform on his behalf all or part of the obligations and formalities connected with this Directive (any natural or legal person established in the Community who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform on his behalf all or part of the obligations and formalities connected with this Directive) [condition: who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer] [DIR, Art. 2]
[60] placing on the market — definedAs — making available for the first time in the Community machinery or partly completed machinery with a view to distribution or use, whether for reward or free of charge (making available for the first time in the Community machinery or partly completed machinery with a view to distribution or use, whether for reward or free of charge) [DIR, Art. 2]
[61] loads creeping or falling freely — addressesRisk — creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly (creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly) [condition: even in the event of partial or total failure of the power supply or when the operator stops operating the machine] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[62] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX (conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[63] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[64] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII (EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[65] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII (EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[66] impianti di messa a terra — requiresCheckAfter — variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione di una diversa normativa tecnica che prevede un aumento del livello di sicurezza (variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione di una diversa normativa tecnica che prevede un aumento del livello di sicurezza) [inail-guide, p. 15]
[67] removable mechanical transmission device — definedAs — removable component for transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and other machinery or related products by joining them at the first fixed bearing (removable component for transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and other machinery or related products by joining them at the first fixed bearing) [REG, Art. 3(9)]

[70] IGEA device 17 — deviceKind — AUTOGRU' (AUTOGRU) [igea-equipment, p. 7]
[71] IGEA device 18 — deviceKind — AUTOGRU' (AUTOGRU) [igea-equipment, p. 7]
[72] IGEA device 20 — deviceKind — AUTOGRU' (AUTOGRU) [igea-equipment, p. 7]
